welcome.title: A tour of the comparisons
welcome.text: A comparison puts lanes of several gels side by side, read for their assay. A one-minute tour; Esc leaves it, the Tour compass at the top brings it back.

steps.title: Start a comparison
steps.text: Start New Comparison opens an empty one: add the lanes of any analysis that has a densitometry.

steps.title: Yours, or everyone's public ones
steps.text: My Comparisons lists the ones you saved; All Comparisons adds those others made public. Search by name. A card opens its comparison; deleting one leaves its gels and analyses untouched.

steps.title: Compare one gel's lanes
steps.text: The latest analyses with a densitometry: Compare lanes opens all the lanes of one of them, side by side.
